desc: Ideation: binary search on D + circular-arc feasibility; answer bounded by side for k>=4.
Implement perimeter mapping (bottom/right/top/left), sort, doubled array, and two-pointer nxt[i] = first j>i with A[j]-A[i] >= D.
Implement feasibility: for each start s in [0,n), greedily follow nxt for k-1 steps staying < s+n, then require nxt[cur] <= s+n (wrap gap >= D).
Binary search D over [0, side] and return the max feasible value.
Validate: run the 3 given examples and a randomized brute-force k-subset comparison; sample tests PASS, no counterexample found.
